display.purpose: The dominant current command or an equally important operational heading.

headline.purpose: Page titles and primary screen headings.

title.purpose: Course, node, pane, and compact section headings.

body.purpose: Interface prose and lesson reading copy.

label.purpose: Short status, metadata, navigation, and control labels.

shadows.name: panel-depth
shadows.purpose: Low structural depth for standard panels.

shadows.name: top-navigation-depth
shadows.purpose: Separates the sticky top navigation from page content.

shadows.name: drawer-depth
shadows.purpose: Separates the open mobile drawer from its backdrop.

shadows.name: primary-action-glow
shadows.purpose: Quiet phosphor response on the primary action.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Color, border, and glow transitions on buttons and controls.

motion.name: current-node-pulse
motion.purpose: Restrained amber pulse on the current node only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main command on a screen or within a focused task region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-phosphor); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-phosphor); color: var(--color-void); padding: 0.65rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.12); transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #75ff55; border-color: #75ff55; box-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cyan); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.14); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary command that keeps the terminal plane visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-phosphor); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-phosphor); padding: 0.65rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.1); color: #75ff55; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cyan); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.16); }

components.name: Terminal Input
components.description: The standard editable field on a dark terminal surface.
components.css: .ds-terminal-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.28); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-input); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; font: 400 1rem / 1.25 var(--font-body); } .ds-terminal-input::placeholder { color: #718078; } .ds-terminal-input:hover { border-color: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.5); } .ds-terminal-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-phosphor); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.13); outline: none; } .ds-terminal-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The standard opaque container for supporting information and learning content.
components.html:
COURSE SIGNAL

Supporting information remains quieter than the current command.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.22); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-panel); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(225, 236, 228, 0.025), 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.15); padding-bottom: 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-static); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Phosphor Badge
components.description: A compact state stamp for XP, completion, or another successful state.
components.css: .ds-badge-phosphor { display: inline-flex; min-height: 1.5rem; align-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.45); background: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.1); color: var(--color-phosphor); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Information Message
components.description: A written status message with a semantic signal that does not rely on color alone.
components.html:
DRAFT SAVED

Your work was saved.
components.css: .ds-status-info { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.2); background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-status-info__dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; flex: none; margin-top: 0.375rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-cyan); } .ds-status-info strong { display: block; font-weight: 700; } .ds-status-info p { margin: 0.2rem 0 0; color: var(--color-static); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.375; }

components.name: Active Sidebar Link
components.description: The active destination in desktop navigation or the mobile drawer.
components.css: .ds-side-link { display: flex; min-height: 2.6rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; border-left: 2px solid transparent; padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem; color: var(--color-static); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.82rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-side-link__index { display: inline-flex; width: 2rem; flex: none; justify-content: center; color: var(--color-phosphor-dim); font-family: var(--font-code); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-side-link:hover { border-left-color: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.4); background: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.045); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-side-link--active { border-left-color: var(--color-phosphor); background: rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.08); color: var(--color-phosphor); } .ds-side-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cyan); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: A labeled measure of completion with a semantic fill and visible percentage.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-progress__label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-progress__label span:last-child { color: var(--color-static); font-family: var(--font-code); } .ds-progress__track { width: 100%; height: 0.625rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 255, 0, 0.15); background: var(--color-void); } .ds-progress__fill { display: block; width: 64%; height: 100%; background: var(--color-phosphor); transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

components.name: Current Progression Node
components.description: The current item on the vertical learning signal rail.
components.html: ●CURRENT03 // Repair the document structureYour next required learning node.
components.css: .ds-path-node { position: relative; padding-left: 3.25rem; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-path-node__marker { position: absolute; top: 1.05rem; left: 0; display: inline-flex; width: 2.4rem; height: 2.4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-amber); background: var(--color-void); color: var(--color-amber); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 176, 0, 0.08), 0 0 18px rgba(255, 176, 0, 0.16); } .ds-path-node__card { display: flex; min-height: 5.15rem; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 176, 0, 0.72); background: var(--color-surface-alt); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.9rem 1rem; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-amber); } .ds-path-node__card:hover { background: #0d1c13; } .ds-path-node__card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-cyan); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-path-node__state { color: var(--color-amber); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.11em; } .ds-path-node__card strong { font-size: 0.94rem; } .ds-path-node__card small { color: var(--color-static); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.45; }

narrative.overview:
CodeQuest looks like a serious learning terminal running inside the System 404 fiction. Near-black opaque layers carry the interface. Phosphor green identifies primary action, successful progress, and active system identity. The atmosphere comes from faint scanlines, narrow glows, precise borders, and compact system labels, never from visual noise over reading or coding areas.

The system is operational first. It uses one monospace family for interface, prose, and code, then creates hierarchy through scale, weight, spacing, and restrained semantic color. The dashboard puts the next command first. Progression appears as an explicit signal rail. Lessons narrow and quiet the frame. Challenges give the editor the largest share of a three-pane workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque near-black layers with dark green undertones
True phosphor green as the primary system signal
Amber, red, and cyan reserved for distinct state meanings
Sharp two-pixel forms and one-pixel structural borders
System monospace throughout, with readable prose leading and clear weight changes
Restrained CRT texture outside the reading and coding planes

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means primary or complete, amber means current or caution, red means error, and cyan means informational or available. Pair every state color with text, a symbol, or both.

rules.name: The Opaque Terminal Rule
rules.body: Panels remain dark and opaque. Do not blur the content behind them or simulate glass.

rules.name: The One Terminal Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep the system monospace stack everywhere. Build hierarchy with size, weight, case, and spacing.

rules.name: The Reading Plane Rule
rules.body: Long-form lesson copy uses relaxed leading and a narrow measure. Compact terminal labels stay short and functional.

rules.name: The Restrained CRT Rule
rules.body: Scanlines and glow belong to the outer atmosphere and active signals. They do not sit over lesson copy, code, or preview output.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a crisp semantic border to define a surface. Add shadow only when the surface needs structural separation or active-state emphasis.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls and standalone containers use the shared two-pixel corner. Do not introduce soft cards or pill-shaped controls.

dos: Do keep the next action visually dominant and place supporting metrics after it.
Do use phosphor for primary action, completion, progress, and active navigation.
Do reserve amber for current work and warnings, red for errors, and cyan for information, availability, and focus.
Do pair state color with plain text, a marker shape, or both.
Do keep lesson reading surfaces calm and challenge workspaces editor-first.
Do preserve the cyan focus outline, keyboard-safe drawer behavior, and reduced-motion override.
Do use subtle scanlines and glow only where they do not compete with reading or coding.
donts: Don't turn CodeQuest into a generic SaaS dashboard or a freeCodeCamp clone.
Don't use glassmorphism, translucent blur panels, or a purple-and-blue AI dashboard palette.
Don't use pixel-art interface chrome or decorative pixel fonts.
Don't add soft card rounding, pill controls, excessive gradients, or ornamental shadows.
Don't animate large regions or add perpetual motion. Keep the current-node pulse restrained and honor reduced motion.
Don't let CRT effects, glow, or texture enter the lesson reading plane, code editor, or preview output.
